ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white) regions localized at the distal tips; approximate ratio of 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark region across the center and base. Discrete high-intensity white patches at the lateral distal tips, with significant pixel-level mottling and transition zones along the upper trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct acute V-shaped notch at the central axis, with a deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations and non-uniform peaks/valleys extending from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curve sweeping outward and upward from the median notch, terminating in sharp, high-intensity distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive high-density clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel objects (barnacles) localized on the outer lateral edges and extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of barnacle clusters forming a thick, irregular secondary border along the lateral margins of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple low-intensity animate objects (pinnipeds/seals) breaking the water surface in the foreground at the base of the fluke.
